verdict.rationale: Automations are a fair axis for a knowledge-management app, but the evidence shows no way to version, review, or roll back automation definitions. The closest feature is object-level Version history, which restores note content after an external assistant edits it, and the AI can propose creates and updates for approval. Both are adjacent content-level controls, not versioning or rollback of automations themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: If an external assistant changes a note in a way you do not want, use Version history on that object to preview and restore an earlier version.
